comment: Every source this reading rests on, pinned. check.sh reads this file, clones what is
missing under the directory IOC_CLONES names (default $TMPDIR/ioc-clones) and resolves
every citation from the clone at the commit below, never from a live branch and never
through gh, which in a Legion pod is scoped to this project's owners and refuses
ioc-project. A published document is read from the committed copy this file names, and
the live address is read only to report whether it still carries the sentence quoted.
